Insightful Command: Passive: +4 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
Parrying +2: +2 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +2 Insight bonus to Saves.
Silver Concord's Subtlety: 2 Pieces Equipped:+10% Artifact bonus to Fortification Bypass+5 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
